authority_boundary_note: The current official page, signed notice, or direct office confirmation remains controlling even when a chat or social platform shows a preview card first.
canonical_destination_policy_note: Shared previews should prefer stable current official destinations over stale election-cycle URLs when a durable current landing page exists.
cross_platform_variation_note: The jurisdiction does not assume every chat or social platform renders the same preview fields, image behavior, or cache timing.
current_state_cue_policy_note: Volatile topics should avoid relying only on evergreen teaser text and should make current cycle, office status, or notice state visible quickly after click-through.
delivery_role_note: Shared-link preview cards may summarize or visually frame official voter information before click-through, but they do not become the controlling authority for jurisdiction-specific election rules.
link_preview_surface_label: Example State official voter-information shared-link preview surface policy
preview_cache_recovery_policy_note: Landing pages should recover safely from cached or forwarded preview drift by exposing current-state cues and immediate routes to the current notice/help lane.
preview_image_policy_note: Preview images, if used, should reinforce office or destination recognition and should not carry time-sensitive instructions that can drift stale more easily than the landing page.
preview_metadata_policy_note: Pages likely to circulate for action-changing topics should keep title, description, site identity, and destination class legible enough that the preview looks recognizably official before click-through.
